text:
Elena: Hey all — I wanted to let you know I've accepted another role and will be leaving Redwood. My last day will be 2026-05-15. Happy to run knowledge transfer and do an exit interview. I also need guidance on COBRA timing, final pay, and details for laptop/badge return. Thanks.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks for letting us know, Elena. Sorry to see you go :wave: Can you confirm your last day and preferred window for an exit interview? We'll send the offboarding checklist and COBRA info once we confirm. Also need a forwarding address for benefits/paperwork.
Elena: Confirming last day 2026-05-15. Morning exit interview works best for me. Forwarding address: 123 Maple Ave, Apt 4, Oakland, CA 94607.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Elena — huge thank you for everything you've built. Please add high-level handoff notes to the docs repo and flag any open PRs. @Recruiting - Samir, I'm going to start the backfill conversation. Let's aim for a Wednesday KT session.
Recruiting - Samir: Thanks Carlos — I'll start the req and sync with you about overlap. Elena, can you DM me the top three responsibilities and who to contact for each?
IT Support - Priya: Hi Elena — IT will arrange either a pickup or a prepaid return label. Can you share the device serial number (S/N) and whether you have the charger/dongle? We'll plan to deprovision accounts after your last day (5/15) unless you request a specific extension. For returns, please ship to: Redwood Returns, PO Box 582, San Francisco, CA.
Elena: S/N: ABCD1234567890. I have the charger and the USB-C dongle. I'll pack it tomorrow and share tracking when I ship.
Benefits - Nora: Quick heads up on benefits: active coverage continues through 5/31 (end of the month). COBRA election materials will be emailed within a few days; the election window is 60 days from your termination date. If you prefer, you can contact benefits@redwood.com or call our vendor at 1-800-555-0199 for questions.
Payroll: Final paycheck timing — payroll will include your final pay and any accrued PTO payout in the 5/22 pay run. Please confirm whether you want funds sent to your current direct deposit or a mailed check.
Elena: Direct deposit is fine — same account as usual.
Security Bot: Badge and building access will be disabled on 2026-05-15 at 18:00 PT. If you need temporary after-hours access for handoff, please request it and we can make a short exception.
Riley (People Ops): We've tentatively scheduled an exit interview for 2026-05-10 at 10:00 PT and sent calendar invite. Please complete this short exit form before then: https://forms.redwood.com/exit. Once IT scans the returned laptop into inventory we'll close the kit and trigger final asset reconciliation.
Elena: Filled the form and accepted the interview slot. Thanks — happy to help make the handoff smooth.
Carlos (Eng Manager): One more ask — can we extend Elena's infra-prod access until 5/20 so she can complete the DB handover? @Riley any concerns?
Riley (People Ops): We can approve scoped access extensions for handoffs. Carlos, please list the specific entitlements (infra-prod, SRE pager, etc.) and we'll route to IT and Security for temporary exceptions.
Carlos (Eng Manager): I'll DM the list by EOD.
IT Support - Priya: Noted. We'll hold deprovision of infra-prod and pager until 5/20 and will restrict other entitlements on 5/15.
Elena: :thumbsup: Thanks, everyone — I appreciate the clear plan. Let me know if there are any forms or additional handoffs you want before my last week.
